preservation: Only ko changes; en, tags, weight and human applicability remain exact.
Retain protective gear, grease-marked hands, harbor+dawn, rice-paddy wet soil work and forge role.
Do not add demographic attributes, specific tools/actions not in the source, a historical era, catch, sparks or an in-frame helmet.
acceptance: Independently verify accurate Korean labels and exact non-ko source preservation.

Freeze English and Korean positive/near-miss pairs before any edit or paid call; do not use the exact full new label as the positive query. These are still authored diagnostics, not a blind benchmark.
Inspect English and Korean rank changes and top-k exposure together. Require a concrete label/coverage benefit for any tradeoff; restore avoidable regressions without compensating evidence.
Do not change routing, schema, weights, English text or add hard exclusions.
pre_freeze_review: Independent reviewer confirmed all five translations and preservation limits. Harbor dawn was narrowed to 동틀 무렵, mechanic Korean positive was made person-headed, and incidental industrial/encounter/small-watch differences were removed before freezing.
limitations: Authored bilingual display/term-coverage diagnostics, not blind generalization or rendered-image evidence.
Untranslated labels outside these five clear occupational clauses are out of scope. Names, brands and intentional borrowed terms are not automatically errors.
Preserve source specialization rather than translating every job into a generic worker.
